question: Where did the 25th edition of the IHF Women's World Handball Championship organize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 25th edition of the IHF Women's World Handball Championship was organized in Spain.
 
• The championship took place from December 1 to December 19, 2021.
 
• Spain hosted the tournament for the first time in the history of the Women's World Handball Championship.
 
• The matches were played across four venues in the cities of Castellón, Granollers, Llíria, and Torrevieja.
 
• Norway won the championship, defeating France in the final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Handball Federation (IHF)**

 
 
• The IHF is the administrative and controlling body for international handball.
 
• It was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland.
 
• The IHF organizes world championships for both men's and women's handball.
 
• The IHF Women's World Handball Championship is held every two years.
 
 
 
• **Handball**
 
 
• Handball is a team sport where two teams of seven players each pass a ball to throw it into the goal of the opposing team.
 
• A standard match consists of two periods of 30 minutes, and the team that scores the most goals wins.
 
• The game is fast-paced and involves significant physical contact, necessitating a high level of fitness and skill.
 
 
 
• **Norway's Women's Handball Team**
 
 
• Norway has a strong women's handball team, consistently performing well in international competitions.
 
• They have won multiple IHF Women's World Handball Championships and European Championships.
 
• The team is known for its tactical play and strong defense.
 
 
 
• **France's Women's Handball Team**
 
 
• France's women's handball team is also highly competitive on the international stage.
 
• They have won several world championships and Olympic medals.
 
• The team is recognized for its agility, speed, and strategic gameplay.
